items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 101:1
items.html: The screen of phase two, upon which the coupling of AVI is made for the sake of the world of Beriah, is discerned as a screen separating upon the light of Hochma, and only the light of Hassadim separated from Hochma is imparted through this screen. And the reason is that her feet touch the Parsa between Atzilut and Beriah, and the screen of phase two in her Yesod is included in the Parsa that concludes all the illumination of Atzilut. Therefore the mouth of the Yesod of Ima, where the coupling is made for the sake of Beriah, is discerned by the name the sealed mouth of the Yesod, or a sealed window, or a screen in the opening of the window, because the window that imparts the lights to Beriah closes upon the light of Hochma. But the Mochin of SAG of Atzilut, although Ima too serves with the screen of phase two in the mouth of her Yesod, nevertheless there the screen does not close upon the light of Hochma, and she can ascend and receive Hochma at the time when she has MAN. Therefore the screen is discerned there by the name an open window, because it is open there to receive Hochma. And likewise the mouth of the Yesod is called open, for that same reason, because there is no separating screen there that would close upon the Hochma. (Item 29).
